semantics.definition: A real radio Eidos draws, with its words: a lime circle with a dark dot when chosen.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one radio every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Choose one of several, with its words; put radios in Choices, so their question is said with them.

interaction.checked: chosen: a lime circle with a dark dot
